What is NCTF Treatment

Tired of dull, dehydrated skin? NCTF treatment is a powerful skin booster that restores hydration, glow, and texture—without surgery or downtime.

NCTF Treatment is a powerful solution for dull, tired-looking skin that no amount of creams or serums can fix. You’re not alone—and luckily, you’re not without options.

One of the most effective innovations in aesthetic medicine today is NCTF treatment. If you’re hearing about it for the first time, you’re probably wondering: What is NCTF, how does it work, and could it be the key to the radiant, youthful skin you’ve been craving?

What Exactly is NCTF?

NCTF (New Cellular Treatment Factor) is a proprietary skin-revitalizing solution developed by Laboratoires Filorga, a pioneer in aesthetic medicine. It’s a polyrevitalizing cocktail composed of:

  • Vitamins (A, B, C, E, etc.)
  • Amino acids
  • Minerals
  • Coenzymes
  • Nucleic acids
  • Hyaluronic acid

This potent mix is injected into the skin using micro-needling or mesotherapy techniques to nourish, hydrate, and stimulate the skin from within.

Who is NCTF Treatment For?

NCTF is ideal for anyone noticing the early signs of aging or skin fatigue. Common concerns it addresses include:

Fine lines and wrinkles Loss of skin firmness Uneven tone or texture Dehydration Dull, lackluster complexion

If you’ve tried topical products with minimal results, NCTF treatment delivers ingredients deep into the dermis where traditional skincare cannot reach.

How Does NCTF Treatment Actually Work?

At our Facelit Clinic, NCTF isn’t just applied—it’s delivered with precision to get real results.

We use two highly effective techniques:

Mesotherapy – This involves a series of tiny, virtually painless injections that deposit the NCTF formula just beneath the surface of your skin. It’s a targeted way to infuse your skin with powerful nutrients exactly where they’re needed.

Microneedling – Using a medical-grade dermapen, we create microscopic channels in your skin that allow the NCTF cocktail to absorb deeply. This not only maximizes product penetration but also naturally stimulates collagen production.

The treatment takes about 30 to 45 minutes, making it perfect even for a lunch break. You might notice slight redness, similar to a mild sunburn, but that typically fades within a few hours—and there’s minimal to no downtime.

Our clients love how quick and comfortable the experience is, especially once they start seeing that radiant, refreshed glow just days later.

What Results Can You Expect?

Most patients report:

Brighter, more even skin tone Softer and smoother texture A “glow” that lasts for weeks Tighter, firmer-looking skin Reduction in fine lines over time

For best results, a protocol of 3 to 5 sessions spaced 1–2 weeks apart is typically recommended, followed by maintenance every few months.

Is NCTF Safe?

Yes. NCTF has been used for over a decade in aesthetic medicine and is CE-marked in Europe. It is:

  • Non-toxic
  • Biocompatible
  • Backed by dermatological research

However, it should always be administered by a trained practitioner at a certified medical aesthetics or facelift clinic to ensure safety and optimal results.

NCTF vs. Other Treatments

Treatment Purpose Method Ideal For
NCTF Revitalization Mesotherapy Early signs of aging
Botox Wrinkle relaxation Injections Expression lines
Fillers Volume restoration Injections Sagging, hollowness
PRP Regeneration Blood plasma Texture, acne scars

NCTF stands out because it doesn’t change your facial structure—it simply enhances what’s already there by restoring hydration and nutrients.

Why Choose a Facelit Clinic for NCTF?

While NCTF may sound simple, the expertise of the practitioner matters. At a professional Facelit clinic, you can expect:

  • Tailored consultations based on your skin goals
  • Medical-grade hygiene and technology
  • Skilled injectors trained in advanced techniques
  • A results-driven treatment plan

We specialize in subtle, natural-looking rejuvenation that makes you look refreshed—not “done.”

Take the First Step to Radiant Skin

Ready to experience the skin-rejuvenating power of NCTF?

Whether you’re just beginning your anti-aging journey or looking for a non-surgical refresh, NCTF treatment could be the game-changer your skin has been waiting for.

Book a consultation at our Facelit clinic today and discover how we can help you turn back the clock—beautifully and naturally.

FAQ Section:

  1. What exactly is NCTF treatment?
  2. Is NCTF only for mature skin or signs of aging?
  3. How is the treatment administered?
  4. Does NCTF treatment hurt?
  5. How long does each session take?

    A typical NCTF session lasts 30 to 45 minutes, making it easy to fit into a busy schedule—even during lunch breaks!

  6. Is there any downtime after the treatment?
  • Downtime is minimal. You may experience slight redness, mild swelling, or sensitivity for a few hours to a day. Most clients return to their regular activities right after the session.
  1. When will I see results?
  2. How long do the results last?

    Results can last for several months depending on your skin condition and lifestyle. We recommend maintenance sessions every 3–6 months to keep your skin looking its best.

  3. Can I combine NCTF with other treatments?
  • Yes! NCTF pairs well with treatments like Botox, fillers, chemical peels, and PRP. During your consultation, we’ll recommend a custom treatment plan based on your skin goals.
  1. Why should I get NCTF treatment at a facelift clinic?

Because experience and technique matter. At our clinic, you’re treated by skilled professionals using only certified, medical-grade products in a safe and sterile environment. We tailor each treatment to your skin’s unique needs—for natural, noticeable results you’ll love.
